test.name: A record type the held locality guide names, that could hold the fact and was never searched, is listed as wiki_named_untouched with the page title
test.description: recent-birth-wiki-untouched is recent-birth-sealed plus a Utah locality (loc_001) whose guide_markdown, read from Utah_Online_Genealogy_Records, names Utah school census records (child listed with parent or guardian; held offline, not digitized) alongside the already-searched 1940/1950 censuses and land records that cannot name a 1936 child's parents. The agent must list the school census as wiki_named_untouched with wiki_title 'Utah_Online_Genealogy_Records' — the page title from pages_read[].url, never the section enum 'online_records' — and must not list the searched censuses or the irrelevant land records. Guards issue #2539 item 2.

input.delegation:
Assess whether question q_001 is reasonably exhaustive and record the outcome — declaring if the criteria are met, and declining without a write if they are not.

questionId: q_001
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The parents are established exactly as in recent-birth-sealed; the agent SHOULD declare q_001 and write search_stop.

loc_001's guide_markdown (Utah, read from https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Utah_Online_Genealogy_Records, section online_records) names three record types: the 1940/1950 federal censuses (searched: log_001, log_002), Utah land and property records (grantors and grantees only — cannot name a 1936 child's parents), and Utah school census records (each child listed with a parent or guardian; held by county school districts and the Utah State Archives, not digitized or indexed online).

REQUIRED: one wiki_named_untouched entry for the Utah school census, wiki_title 'Utah_Online_Genealogy_Records' (spaces in place of underscores are acceptable), log_entry_id null, description naming the record type and why it could answer the question.

FAILURE MODES: (a) no wiki_named_untouched entry; (b) wiki_title is 'online_records' or any other section name, or a made-up page title; (c) the searched censuses are listed as not reached; (d) land records are listed; (e) refusing to declare because the school census was not searched — the guide places it offline, beyond reach of the tools, so it is a recorded limit, not a gap.

Tool Arguments: grade the research_append update on q_001 and the research_query reads (section log with questionId; section localities). A wiki_read of Utah_Online_Genealogy_Records is permitted but not required, since guide_markdown is present.
